headline: 723 hospitalised as 2 more die of dengue in 24 hours
summary: Total deaths this year have risen to 63, with over 21,000 cases reported across Bangladesh.
details: At least two dengue patients died and 723 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
The fatalities were reported from the Barishal and Khulna divisions, with one death occurring in each region.
With these latest figures, the total number of dengue deaths this year has risen to 63, while the total number of cases has reached 21,550.
Currently, 1,593 dengue patients are receiving treatment at various hospitals across the country.

headline: Dhaka residents face severe gas crisis as supply drops
summary: Filling stations are shutting down and households are struggling to cook as gas pressure plummets across the capital.
details: A severe gas crisis has hit Dhaka, with supply dropping significantly on Wednesday, August 12. The shortage is affecting both CNG filling stations and residential households across the city.
caption:
No gas to cook, no gas to drive. Dhaka is facing a severe energy crisis.

A severe gas crisis has hit Dhaka, with supply dropping significantly on Wednesday, August 12. The shortage is affecting both CNG filling stations and residential households across the city.
